title: History
description: ISC Class XI History themes for the board examination.

syllabusBaselines.source: CISCE, ISC Examination Year 2027 Regulations and Syllabuses - History (subject code 851) (www.cisce.org).
syllabusBaselines.note: Verified October 2026 against the CISCE-copyrighted February 2025 History (851) syllabus document carrying the ISC Year 2027 heading and a CLASS XI section, read through its AglaSem reproduction because cisce.org returns 403 to automated fetches, with a Scribd copy as corroboration. The ISC subject is History (851), distinct from the ICSE Class X 'History and Civics'. Class XI prescribes Paper I Theory (80 marks) in Section A Indian History and Section B World History, and Paper II Project Work (20 marks); all twelve units are registered below.
